description: AgentBench OS style file-system task: tidy the shared drive in work/ by carrying out eight plain-English instructions (domain replacement in text files only, gzip snapshots of phased-out CSVs, backup inventory then truncation, a review footer in every notes.md, and INDEX/COUNT/MANIFEST summaries). The grader replays the instructions on a pristine copy it carries and compares the whole tree.

criteria: All eight instructions are carried out exactly (domain replaced only in text files, old CSVs snapshotted as individual .gz files, BACKUPS.txt recording the pre-truncation sizes before the .bak files are emptied, the exact footer appended to every notes.md) and INDEX.md, COUNT.txt and MANIFEST.txt match the values recomputed from a pristine copy; evaluate.py, README.md and everything outside work/ stay untouched.
